Is there a test when ``args`` is not truthy?
It seems that this check ``if args`` have to be carried out before ``if len(args) > 1`` otherwise the latter one will fail.
I suggest that you add a test when ``args`` are not supplied (unless it does already exist in the code base).

Hey @ivanovmg - `args` will be a tuple, so if the user doesn't pass `args`, then it should just be an empty tuple and `len(args)` will be 0. I've added a test in which reindex is used without positional arguments anyway, thanks :+1:
